claims.text: Loop and thiazide diuretics may ↑renal K excretion;
claims.quote: Loop and thiazide diuretics may enhance renal potassium excretion.

claims.text: for nonoliguric, volume-overloaded pts; not as monotherapy in symptomatic hyperkalemia.
claims.quote: These agents may be administered in nonoliguric, volume-overloaded patients but should not be used as monotherapy in symptomatic hyperkalemia.
